image_description: A Roseate Spoonbill standing in shallow, rippling water. The bird has distinctive pink plumage on its body and wings, a white neck with a yellow patch near the shoulder, and a long, flat, spatulate black bill. Its legs are dark and partially submerged. To the right, there is a blurred foreground element resembling dried vegetation or driftwood.

The neck is visibly long and exhibits a gentle S-curve posture typical of spoonbills when foraging or standing.
